scope: Inline-quote configuration, activation, placement, nesting, loading and removal from the permitted public extension; inspected as text only.

extension.offset_units: Zero-based string offsets in the pinned ASCII release

contract.activation: Primary clicks on an exact quote-link target select inline behavior before mobile preview handling, independently of quotePreview. The public branch excludes archive pages and disabled native features.
contract.modifiers: Shift follows the existing destination in the same window; the public inline branch does not exempt Control, Meta or Alt. Non-primary clicks and navigation companions bypass it.
contract.mobile_setting: The checkbox is omitted from the public mobile settings layout; an already stored inlineQuotes value still takes effect.
contract.identity: A direct self-quote retains navigation. Ancestor cycles are suppressed. Different source links may expand the same target independently.
contract.placement: Ordinary copies follow the source anchor or its immediate quote wrapper, lifted through consecutive spoiler ancestors. A desktop backlink prepends a local copy into its owner's message and reference-counts hiding of the original target. Mobile backlinks use ordinary adjacent placement.
contract.copies: Local copies retain the existing display content but remove nested inline copies and highlight effects. Remote copies are built from a public thread response and use normal post presentation.
contract.loading: A pending remote request shows a loading element. Repeated activation during the request does not start another. Missing or failed responses remain visible; later activation can remove the error and retry.
contract.collapse: Activating the source again removes its copy and restores its owned faded-link and original-target effects. Nested copies require consistent cleanup.

required_rewrite_boundaries: Use strict same-origin routes and exact board, thread and positive i64 post identities; do not inherit board-blind DOM lookup.
Reuse the existing bounded one-post projection, validated parser tree and approved media grammar; never parse response HTML in the live document or import forms and credentials.
Keep a separate bounded inline request owner, fresh responses and total pending/open/nesting/DOM budgets; cancel stale work when source, setting or page lifecycle changes.
Exclude only controller-owned projections from canonical post readers and original comment/filter/notification inputs; arbitrary matching classes cannot grant exclusion.
Recursively release descendant requests and owned original-hide effects; preserve independent manual and filter hiding.
Keep the original navigation companion usable and adjacent to its source, and arbitrate inline, preview and ordinary navigation before either feature activates.

The public mouseover handler is device-agnostic. For an exact touch-generated mobile mouseover whose remote inline activation can be admitted, a read-only ownership predicate defers the preview request; other hover paths remain available. This bounded request-arbitration replacement is verified with trusted taps, not attributed to the public handler.
A one-post unavailable response cannot distinguish the public client's missing-thread and missing-post errors; use an accurate common unavailable state.
Preserve the existing worker ceiling and network/CSP authority. No leaked source, original runtime, production posts or production media fixtures are imported.
